brief: A breathtaking, complex steampunk sculpture dominates the canvas. Deep emerald glass tracery forms intricate, crystalline structures latticework, suspended and orbiting a central, rotating cube. Tarnished copper splines guide the motion, while the entire piece is animated by visible energy. This energy radiates through the latticework and along deep veins, causing the crystalline structures to pulse and discharge intense, pulsing energy bursts. The colors are rich, featuring deep emerald greens, oxidized copper browns, and brilliant, electric energy discharge highlights.

statement: This sketch renders a steampunk-inspired sculpture composed of geometric crystalline structures suspended around a central rotating cube. The piece combines deep emerald greens with oxidized copper browns and bright energy discharges, creating a sense of volumetric complexity through layered forms. The animated elements include orbiting points that emit glowing trails, pulsating crystal formations that expand and contract, and intense energy bursts that radiate from the central structure. The viewer experiences a dynamic interplay of motion and light as the entire composition evolves in real-time, driven by a continuous animation loop that maintains visual complexity without exceeding performance constraints.
